tc.research_text.FOCUSINFUSION: Looks cool, but what does it do?
tc.research_page.FOCUSINFUSION.1: After researching for countless hours, you have now finally unlocked the knowledge of the most powerful infusions known to Thaumaturgy. This focus gives you the power to take individual aspects and infuse them into any block within the world. When infused with an aspect, a block will then have a very unique effect depending on which aspect has been infused within it. To wield this focus correctly, one must first equip the focus onto their wand, after carefully constructing it from arcane infusion.
tc.research_page.FOCUSINFUSION.2: Once equipped, right click with your wand and then a menu should pop up showing what aspects you will be able to infuse. However, before you can begin waving your wand around Harry Potter style shouting "Wingardium Leviosaaaa" attempting to infuse all blocks within sight, you will also require a jar full of essentia of the aspect that you wish to infuse, sat convieniently next to you. Only once you have done this, will you be able to choose your desired aspect through the infusion menu and right click on any block to infuse the aspect into it. To displace aspects from a block, simply shift click it with your wand equipped.
tc.research_page.FOCUSINFUSION.3: Note: When infusing, each aspect requires a small amount of it for the infusion process to actually function (indicated beside each icon within the menu), and this is directly taken from the jar of essentia that you should have placed in the vicinity.
tc.research_page.ESSENTIABLOCKS.1: Essentia blocks are as they say on the tin, simply aspects in a solidified block form. The process for creating them is also a simple one; just place four phials containing the same essentia in an arcane workbench in a square shape and - voila! You now have a very aesthetically pleasing block. Go nuts.

ti.effect_info.EXANIMIS: After infusion, any player that happens to die while standing on the infused block will be teleported straight back to it upon respawn. Just the thing for dangerous environments!
ti.effect_info.FABRICO: This neat little aspect adds a world of colours to every single block (in other words, any block can become any colour!) All you have to do is grab a phial of an aspect which is the colour that you want the block to be, then right click on the block with the phial, to dye the block.
ti.effect_info.LUX: Does what more or less what you'd expect, causes any block that is infused with this to become a light source, that is equal to a torch. Predictable, but useful.
ti.effect_info.SANO: A very useful aspect, if you are nice and fed that is. It simply regenerates your health based on your hunger level. Soothing to the touch.
ti.effect_info.PANNUS: HI! Billy Mays here, showing you the new aspect you should infuse into your blocks: PANNUS! Ever died from fall damage? Well worry no more, with these new and improved padded blocks, which will negate all fall damage of any player, that is if you land on them. Don't worry, if you don't, the effect comes with a free bucket to scoop yourself into. ONLY $19.99!
ti.effect_info.COGNITIO: Do you hate bookcases? Why what's wrong with them? Well in any case, this effect causes blocks to act like bookcases and increase the enchantment levels of nearby enchantment tables. Knowledge is power!
ti.effect_info.ITER: If you hate walking then this is the effect for you. This multi-dimensional teleporter works by having two effects placed down in the world and shifting while standing on one to teleport seamlessly between them. To link the two effects up, simply take a piece of paper and right click on the infused block. This will imbue the coordinates into the paper. Then right click on the other infused block to link them.
ti.effect_info.ALIENIS: Not much uses in this one, but fun to troll people with. This aspect has a strange effect, where if you interact with the block in any way you will be teleported randomly in the local area.
ti.effect_info.TEMPESTAS: THUNDER! Na na na na naaa na na. THUNDER! Ahem..to explain, while raining, lighting is more likely to strike the block that is infused.
ti.effect_info.VOLATUS: Yet another effect that does what you would probably think. While standing above the block infused with this, You gain flight! But only while above the infused block and only 10 blocks high, which can be increased by infusing blocks below each other.
ti.effect_info.SPIRITUS: This is a clever one for hiding your precious valuables. When infused into a block, it no longer has any collisions and any entity can pass right though it. So basically you can walk through solid objects like a ghost. Who woulda thunk it?
ti.effect_info.TERRA: A neat effect, this causes blocks to have gravity. Which means it has the properties of sand and gravel!
ti.effect_info.FAMES: Not a very helpful effect, it seems to eat away at your hunger when you step on a block infuse with it. So why would you use it? I dunno find a use!
ti.effect_info.BESTIA: Have you ever looked at the top of your house or went into your basement only to see a creeper or a small annoying horde of baby zombies maybe? Well, with this effect make that a thing of the past, as it will stop any aggressive mob from spawning. Hooray! No more annoying groaning or destroyed valuables!
ti.effect_info.VITIUM: Stops pesky taint from spreading across the infused block. Simple, but effective if you don't want purple stuff growing out of your arcane infusion chamber. And why would the taint aspect stop taint? Double negative.
ti.effect_info.MESSIS: Ever wanted to grow crops on any block? Well, this effect turns any block into a disguised farm block, so no more worrying about having to hoe grass. The farmers won't be pleased. Or will they? Well, we'll find out one way or another.
ti.effect_info.IGNIS: Upon infusion, a fire that is placed on the block will never run out and the Ignis aspect will fuel the fire. Much like Netherrack, but with more magic and less ugly block.
ti.effect_info.PERDITIO: This effect is quite dangerous, any interaction with the block after infusion makes it prone to exploding. Handle with extreme care!
ti.effect_info.VINCULUM: After infusion, the block  will immobilize any entity that so happens to step onto the block. Great for stopping mobs in their tracks! Also, pet creepers.
ti.effect_info.PERMUTATIO: Ever wanted to swap blocks between each other? Well, this works by having two effects placed down in the world and applying a redstone signal to one of the linked blocks to swap between them. To link the two effects up, simply take a piece of paper and right click on the infused block. This will imbue the coordinates into the paper. Then right click on the other infused block to link them.
ti.effect_info.PRAECANTATIO: Use this aspect to mark a jar and other aspect containers as suppliers for all neighbouring infusions.
ti.effect_info.LUCRUM: This greedy little thing likes to pull in any item it can find, which just happens to be on the ground towards itself. Basically, EA and your money.
ti.effect_info.MORTUUS: If you supply this effect with a jar that is filled with more Mortuus and is within 10 blocks, the effect will spawn aggressive mobs during night and will drain the jar.
ti.effect_info.VICTUS: If you supply this effect with a jar that is filled with more Victus and is within 10 blocks, the effect will spawn friendly mobs during night and will drain the jar.
ti.effect_info.VITREUS: This effect makes light pass though the block like glass, useful for building a skylight without the need of glass. Let the light shine upon you!
ti.effect_info.VENENUM: Any player who is unfortunate enough to stand on top of a block which is infused with this will be poisoned!
ti.effect_info.AER: Ever wanted to jump like Super Mario? Well you can now when a block is infused with this! Just stand atop it and you will receive a small jump boost! Haha lets a go!
ti.effect_info.MACHINA: This effect provides a simpler form of wireless redstone. This works by having two effects placed down in the world and then giving it a signal which will be outputted on the other end. To link the two effects up, simply take a piece of paper and right click on the infused block. This will imbue the coordinates into the paper. Then right click on the other infused block to link them. Works cross-dimension.
ti.effect_info.POTENTIA: This effect gives you the power. It outputs a redstone signal. Not much to say on this one really.
ti.effect_info.HUMANUS: Warding itself is very powerful, however it has its limitations. This effect will allow you to infuse any block and that block will become unbreakable! However the infusion can be removed by anyone with an infusion foci.
ti.effect_info.ORDO: If you ever wanted to make the infusion altar slightly less...explosive, then this is the effect for you. Infuse any block near the altar with this and it will stabilise it to a point where it isn't so...explosive.
ti.effect_info.SENSUS: The power of sight is a wonderful thing, so why not use it to manipulate your enemies' way of seeing you? When you infuse a block with this aspect, you can disguise it with any other block of your choosing by left clicking it with your preferred block. Hidden bases and traps? Make it so.
ti.effect_info.GELUM: Let it go...let it g...I'm not even gonna bother. All this aspect does when infused into a block, is that it will turn nearby water into ice and solid blocks will have a chance to have snow spawn on top of it. You could even say this aspect is quite...cool. I'm sorry.
ti.effect_info.INFERNUS: Sets any entity that happens to touch this block on fire. So use with caution unless you want to become fried chicken.
ti.command.clean.confirm: This clears all block infusions in this dimension. Confirm with /cleandata confirm.

ti.book.effects:
Infusion effects

Original descriptions are preserved. Inaccurate passages are struck through and followed by green corrections. Each effect also includes details from the current implementation.

There are 32 implementations, including one shown only with Forbidden Magic. Costs apply when adding an infusion; spawning mobs also consumes essentia. Values assume defaults; 20 ticks are about a second. Servers can disable effects or adjust some settings.
ti.book.linking:
Linking blocks

%1$s, %2$s and %3$s need two blocks with the same infusion. Right-click one with paper, then the other with the resulting coordinate paper. Both ends link, even across dimensions, and ordinary paper is returned. The target must be loaded.

Paper prioritizes %4$s, then %5$s, then %6$s when several linking effects share a block. Remove earlier-priority effects to link a later one.
tc.research_text.thaumicinfusion:FOCUSIN: Looks cool, but what does it do?
ti.effect_detail.EXANIMIS: If this infusion is at the player feet or directly below when they die, their next respawn teleports them above that block, even across dimensions. Does not preserve dropped items. The pending return is lost when the server stops.
ti.effect_detail.FABRICO: Left-click with an aspect-storing item, such as a filled essentia phial, to tint the block using its first aspect color. Consumes neither the item nor its contents. Multiplies the original texture colors; shape and function stay the same.
ti.effect_detail.LUX: Sets the block light emission to level 14, the same as a normal torch.
ti.effect_detail.SANO: Every 50 ticks, each player within the block bounds expanded by 15 blocks has a 50% chance to heal 1 health point (half a heart), provided their food level is above zero. Does not consume food or require a full hunger bar.
ti.effect_detail.PANNUS: Resets fall distance when a living entity lands on this block, preventing that fall damage. Also clears fall distance each tick for living entities touching the block or the space directly above it.
ti.effect_detail.COGNITIO: Sets the block enchantment power bonus to 1, equivalent to one bookshelf. The enchanting table still requires a valid position and clear space.
ti.effect_detail.ITER: Link two %1$s-infused blocks with paper, then sneak above one to teleport above the other, including across dimensions. The target must be loaded and still infused with %1$s. Does not load distant chunks or check clearance above the destination.
ti.effect_detail.ALIENIS: Each tick, randomly teleports living entities touching the block or the space immediately above it. By default, searches loaded positions from -10 to +9 on each axis, with two air blocks above a non-air block. Does nothing if none qualify. Range is configurable.
ti.effect_detail.TEMPESTAS: During a thunderstorm, if the space above the block sees the sky, every 50 ticks has a 1/50 chance to summon real lightning above it. Ordinary rain does not qualify.
ti.effect_detail.VOLATUS: If the space above is air, grants flight in a one-block-wide vertical column, 10 blocks high by default. Each consecutive %1$s-infused block below adds another 10. Leaving removes flight granted by this effect. Height and check interval are configurable.
ti.effect_detail.SPIRITUS: Removes the block collision shape and suffocation check so entities can pass through it. Keeps the block appearance.
ti.effect_detail.TERRA: Each tick, if the block directly below is air, makes this block fall like sand, carrying its block-entity data. Restores infusions after landing as the same block type. Water or other non-air blocks below do not start the fall.
ti.effect_detail.FAMES: Fames infusion is not implemented in this version and cannot be selected.
ti.effect_detail.BESTIA: Makes the block fail the valid-spawn-surface check for all entity types, including friendly and hostile mobs. Does not remove existing mobs or stop spawning methods that bypass that check.
ti.effect_detail.VITIUM: Vitium infusion is not implemented in this version and cannot be selected.
ti.effect_detail.MESSIS: Makes the block pass plant-support and fertile-soil checks. Only plants using those checks benefit. Does not actually turn it into farmland, apply bonemeal or directly advance crop growth.
ti.effect_detail.IGNIS: Makes every face a sustaining fire source, sets its flammability to zero and gives it a very high fire-spread speed. Fire must be lit separately. Does not directly ignite entities.
ti.effect_detail.PERDITIO: While a non-sneaking player touches the block or the space directly above, each tick has a 1/20 chance to remove this %1$s infusion and cause a power-4 block explosion. Clicking alone, sneaking players and other mobs do not trigger it.
ti.effect_detail.VINCULUM: Each tick, sets velocity to zero for living entities, including players, touching the block or the two blocks above it. Clears velocity; does not lock their coordinates or prevent teleportation.
ti.effect_detail.PERMUTATIO: Link two %1$s-infused blocks with paper. When either end changes between powered and unpowered, swaps their block states and block-entity data, even across dimensions. Target must be loaded; unbreakable blocks are rejected. Infusions stay at their positions.
ti.effect_detail.PRAECANTATIO: Currently only stores the infusion mark and participates in the normal overlay visible while holding an infusion focus. Adds no special essentia-supply or other behavior. Nearby vessels work without this infusion.
ti.effect_detail.LUCRUM: By default, every 4 ticks pulls item entities within the block bounds expanded by 10 blocks horizontally toward it. Leaves items less than 1 block from its center alone. Does not collect or insert them into inventories. Range and interval are configurable.
ti.effect_detail.MORTUUS: With light level at most 8 and two air blocks above, each tick has a 1/1000 chance to spend 8 %1$s from a nearby vessel and spawn a random creeper, skeleton, spider, zombie, slime or enderman. A successful spawn has a 40-tick cooldown. Time of day is not checked.
ti.effect_detail.VICTUS: With light level at least 8 and two air blocks above, each tick has a 1/1000 chance to spend 8 %1$s from a nearby vessel and spawn a random pig, sheep, cow or chicken. A successful spawn has a 40-tick cooldown. Daylight and grass are not required.
ti.effect_detail.VITREUS: Sets the block light-blocking value to zero. Does not make its texture transparent or change collision. Final lighting still depends on surrounding blocks and the lighting engine.
ti.effect_detail.VENENUM: Every 80 ticks, gives players within the block bounds expanded by 1 block Poison I for 5 seconds, including beside and below it. Does not poison other living entities.
ti.effect_detail.AER: Every 40 ticks, gives players within the block bounds expanded by 1 block Jump Boost I for 5 seconds. Players beside or below the block can also be affected.
ti.effect_detail.MACHINA: Link two %1$s-infused blocks with paper for wireless redstone, including across dimensions. If any neighbor of the target supplies a signal, this end emits weak power 15. Ignores %1$s-infused input neighbors. The target must be loaded.
ti.effect_detail.POTENTIA: Continuously emits level-15 strong and weak redstone power in every direction, without an external power source.
ti.effect_detail.HUMANUS: Prevents survival mining, ordinary entity destruction and explosion destruction, and rejects mob spawning on the block. Anyone using an infusion focus can still remove the effect; it is not an ownership lock.
ti.effect_detail.ORDO: Lets the block act as an infusion-altar stabilizer. Altar scan range, symmetry and the core stability rules still apply; this does not guarantee a safe infusion.
ti.effect_detail.SENSUS: Left-click with a block item whose default state renders as solid to disguise the infused block with its textures. Keeps the original geometry, collision and function. Sneak-left-click clears the disguise. Does not consume the held block.
ti.effect_detail.GELUM: Every 200 ticks, checks only the position 10 blocks lower on each of X, Y and Z. Water becomes ice. Otherwise, if that position is not a snow layer, sees the sky and has air above, places snow above it. Does not search other nearby water.
ti.effect_detail.INFERNUS: Each tick, sets living entities touching the block or the space directly above it on fire for 8 seconds. Requires an addon such as Forbidden Magic to register the %1$s aspect before it appears in the selection menu.
ti.book.usage:
Additional controls

Outside creative mode, only discovered, enabled aspects can be selected. A single vessel must provide each full payment, within -10 to +9 on each axis around the player, in loaded chunks. No wand vis is used.

Clearing the selection removes all effects and refunds essentia to nearby vessels; excess is lost. Selecting an existing effect removes only that effect without a refund, charging it again if multiple effects were present.
ti.book.essentia_details: Recipe details: four full phials of one aspect (8 units each), arranged 2x2, cost 4 %1$s vis and make one block. Four matching blocks make one brick; four matching bricks make one chiseled brick. Each later recipe also costs 4 %2$s vis.
